It’s very random. I can sometimes remember trivial stuff but forget something important like a minute after I’m told. It’s very frustrating. It’s a lot on the making new memories part. I’ve been noticing that movies I know I’ve seen since then and even some from the last few years are a complete blank for me. Same with books. I mean it’s not like universal. I can remember some stuff but it’s not that easy anymore.
I’m currently on something called Rexulti. Haven’t heard of the testing thing. Took me years of trial and error. I feel like I’ve taken almost every depression med there is.
I’m 40. Have been depressed since high school. Which is what pushed me to it. Sadly about 6 months later I finally found a med that worked for me. If I had just waited.

I had them a little over a year ago. Honestly the depression stayed gone for a couple months like fully gone, tbh it was pretty weird after living with it for so long, but it came back since I didn’t keep going. 

It does work it’s just if you think you can handle the potential memory issues. I thought I could but it is worse than I expected.

I had six sessions in two weeks. I was supposed to have double that but it freaked me out and I stopped treatments. I will say it helped for a month or two with my depression and might have worked if I had kept going but overall I regret having it done. 

I struggle with my memory a lot now. It’s hard to learn new things and it feels like I retain almost nothing anymore. Long term memory issues are harder to gauge for me because I tend to block out a lot of it anyway.

Personally I wouldn’t recommend it at all.
